data.one_liner: Annotation package for configuring openapi_generator client SDKs.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations like @Openapi to configure the generation of client SDKs from OpenAPI specifications. Works in conjunction with the openapi_generator package.
use_when: You are using openapi_generator to generate client SDKs from OpenAPI specs in your Dart or Flutter project
avoid_when: You are not using code generation for OpenAPI specs
strengths: Enables clean configuration of OpenAPI generators via annotations
weaknesses: Dependent on external OpenApi generator tools and specifications
data.setup_notes: Add openapi_generator_annotations to dependencies and openapi_generator to dev_dependencies, then configure with annotations and run build_runner.
